title: Paying the minimum on a $3,000 credit card takes over 12 years

beats.text: Jake owes 3,000 dollars on his credit card. Paying just the minimum? It takes over 12 years.
Here's where his money really goes, and the number on his bill that gets him out.
His first monthly minimum is 85 dollars. But 55 of that is interest.
His card charges 22 percent a year, so only 30 dollars touches the debt.
Worse, as the debt shrinks, the minimum shrinks too. So it drags on, and on.
In the end, he pays over 7,000 dollars. For a 3,000 dollar debt.
But the way out is printed right on his bill. About 115 dollars a month clears it in 3 years.
Same debt, 9 years sooner, and he keeps about 2,900 dollars. Do you pay more than the minimum?
